visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown hair and glasses, wearing a grey t-shirt and dark pants, holds up a large green reusable bag with white cloud and '福' patterns. He sits on a blue textured sofa in a brightly lit room. In the background, shelves with toy trucks and other items are visible. (2) The man begins talking animatedly, moving the bag around. A small girl with dark hair, wearing a face mask and a pink long-sleeved shirt, enters the frame and sits next to him, holding a panda plush toy. (3) The man reaches into the bag and pulls out a small green plush toy shaped like a character, still in its plastic packaging. He demonstrates how the toy is actually a foldable shopping bag that can be tucked inside the character's head. (4) He then pulls out a large pink box featuring cartoon bear characters, labeled '福利熊 1,000片益智拼圖'. He shows the front and back of the box to the camera. (5) He continues unboxing, showing two packs of facial tissues, a set of red envelopes, and a large folded sheet filled with colorful coupons. He points at various sections of the coupon sheet while talking. (6) He brings out a yellow box of zipper bags, a small green box of lutein jelly, and a plastic bottle of '熟成紅茶'. (7) The man holds several items together while a large red graphic overlay appears on the screen, showing luxury cars as part of a lucky draw promotion. He concludes by looking at the camera.

The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (3) A sharp crinkling sound of thin plastic film tearing and being manipulated dominates the mix for a few seconds. The narrator explains the toy's function with an enthusiastic pitch. (4) A dull thud sound occurs as a cardboard box is handled and placed against a soft surface. The narrator's voice remains dominant and projected. (5) Multiple rustling sounds of paper and soft plastic are audible as tissues and coupons are handled. The BGM continues with a steady 4/4 beat. (7) The narrator wraps up with a concluding statement about the lucky draw while the BGM maintains its upbeat energy before eventually fading out.
